_notes.datum: XY follows the sloped console; Y=0 is the inner lower crease; Z=0 is the flat pad. Phone camera end is +Y. Thickness is perpendicular to the pad.
_notes.phone: User confirmed 71.1 x 150 mm. Body thickness 8.8 mm retained, body+housing 11.7, body+lenses 13.8. Bottom back seats at Z=0; the first 36 mm of the phone footprint is clear of print.
_notes.console: Nub base centerlines and end positions retained. V5 finished underside mouths are 13.5 mm wide as requested, overriding historical 18 mm nub-width estimates and previous clearance allowances.
_notes.nub_openings: Upper mouths remain 5.6 mm finished. Right upper end reductions remain 6 mm lower / 5 mm upper. Left upper ends now inset 2 mm each provisionally, with smoothstep curvature through thickness; underside end datums retained.
_notes.camera: Centered 64.5 x 41.5 housing, Y=105 to146.5 in the phone datum. Aperture 65.1 x42.1 with 0.3 per-side clearance. No extra blending relief or opening-enlarging rim chamfer. Housing R6 remains provisional.
_notes.height: Shared outer top plane: Z=1 at Y=0 to Z=4.4 at upper assembly edge. Phone-bearing plane passes through the bottom crease and outer plane at Y=150. Outboard lower structural edges stay 1 mm. Hard installed Z limit 4.5 mm.
_notes.wall: V5 provisional fit changes: outer left edge shifted inward 2 mm; lower-left outline corner R15 (was R9); console-facing external edge round R0.9 (was R0.5). Measured left-wall slope retained; contour gauge still pending.
_notes.charging: Retain bottom crease position and central opening. Coil location is not measured; no charging performance claim. Compare the new fit with the bare-phone baseline.
_notes.prototype: V5 fit iteration; no printer dispatch authorized for this revision. Lens contact remains an explicit nonblocking diagnostic. All contour changes are provisional until physical test.
_notes.scan: Old scan calibrated to 72.1 mm width is supporting evidence only; new user measurements take precedence.
